itemdesc-wire-*: A coil of drawn wire. Needed for dynamos, motors and power lines.
blockdesc-wiredrawing-*: A bench for drawing metal rods into wire. Place it as a wooden frame and finish it with right clicks: 4 iron rods, a gear rack, a draw die, 2 iron plates and a wire-drawing pinion. On the finished bench, put a rod into the input slot and hold right click on the crank: the carriage pulls it through the die.
itemdesc-drawdie-*: A plate with a sized hole that wire is pulled through. Part of the wire-drawing bench.
itemdesc-gearrack-*: A toothed bar that the carriage pinion rolls along. Part of the wire-drawing bench.
itemdesc-pinion-*: A gear on the crank axle: it rolls along the gear rack and pulls the carriage. Part of the wire-drawing bench.
blockdesc-rollingmill-*: A hand-cranked mill with two steel rolls. The smooth part of the rolls flattens an ingot into a sheet, the grooves turn it into rods.
